dataset.name: KinCoRe (Kinase Conformation Resource) structure labels
dataset.type: expert-defined conformational labels of public kinase crystal structures
dataset.description: Spatial DFG label (DFGin/DFGinter/DFGout), dihedral label (BLAminus, ...), C-helix label per PDB chain, with sequences (PK_labels_PDB.fasta)

source.primary_reference: Modi & Dunbrack, PNAS 116:6818-6827 (2019), doi:10.1073/pnas.1814279116; KinCoRe website https://dunbrack.fccc.edu/kincore/ (site states 'Last updated 2026-05-25'); newer criteria preprint doi:10.64898/2026.02.19.706771 (not read)

licence.quoted_text: No licence or terms of use found on the KinCoRe home, download or about pages (read 2026-10-24). GitHub DunbrackLab/Kincore-standalone2 and -standalone3: no licence file (GitHub API license=none).
licence.paper_licence: PNAS 2019 article: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (PMC6452665 license element); its supplementary Datasets S1-S3 presumably under the same licence (not downloaded)

internal_evaluation.evidence: no licence stated for the KinCoRe data; PNAS supplement CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 would make use non-commercial with no redistribution of adapted material

publication_of_derived_results.evidence: no licence stated for the KinCoRe data; PNAS supplement CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 would make use non-commercial with no redistribution of adapted material

redistribution_of_derived_files.evidence: no licence stated for the KinCoRe data; PNAS supplement CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 would make use non-commercial with no redistribution of adapted material

later_commercial_use.evidence: no licence stated for the KinCoRe data; PNAS supplement CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 would make use non-commercial with no redistribution of adapted material

downloaded: HTML pages (home, download, about) only; no data files
size_and_download.budget_note: PK_labels_PDB.fasta 5,502,947 bytes (HTTP Content-Length); All coordinate files zip 1,596,199,077 bytes (not needed: structures can come from the PDB, CC0)

independence.prior_topofold_use: none; KIN-DESC-1 used the Modi & Dunbrack definitions (paper text) and 4 Abl chains labelled from Ayaz et al., not KinCoRe labels
independence.overlap_with_other_datasets: KinCoRe includes Abl structures (e.g. 1OPJ, 1OPK, 2F4J may be present); KIN-DESC-1 chains must be excluded or reported separately
independence.equal_information_constraints: KinCoRe labels are computed from side-chain and backbone geometry (D1/D2, dihedrals, Cβ distance). Agreement of TopoFold's kinase_geometry with them is a geometry implementation check, not independent biological validation. For Cα-only representations they are independent expert-defined labels.

endpoint.measurement: crystallographic conformational state labels assigned by published geometric criteria

replicates.run_independence: not applicable (static structures); several chains/entries per kinase are not independent samples

mapping.reference_numbering: UniProt (KinCoRe provides UniProt-renumbered files and an alignment)
mapping.method: to verify by exact sequence matching per chain
mapping.atoms_needed: backbone N, CA, C, O and CB/CG/CZ of DFG-Phe, CB of K and E (atom_adapter roles)

reasons: labels are expert-defined, conformational and independent of TopoFold's Cα outputs
size is small (5.5 MB labels; structures from PDB)
licence and permitted use are not stated; the paper's CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 would limit use to non-commercial, without redistribution of adapted labels
open_conditions: Owner decision: use KinCoRe labels for internal, non-commercial evaluation without a stated licence, or obtain written permission from the Dunbrack laboratory (owner contact; nothing sent by me)
If permitted: download PK_labels_PDB.fasta (5.5 MB), record SHA-256, and draw the PDB structures from RCSB (CC0) within a stated budget
Results based on these labels would be internal and non-commercial unless the permission says otherwise

notes: No data file was downloaded. Only HTML pages and HTTP headers were read.
